RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

The panel's composition isn't evidence of anything on its own. More importantly, the person selected is also a woman, which removes the obvious mechanism by which your sex could have counted against you. Raising it would read as grievance rather than argument and would undercut your credibility on the point that actually has traction.

That point is process: you asked for written reasons two weeks ago and got silence. Follow up in writing, to HR and the hiring authority, citing any policy or statutory timeline. Ask specifically how the criteria were weighted and why consultation experience outranked a master's, licence and twelve years' experience. If the answer is thin, that's your leverage — and useful feedback regardless.
